prompt:
电商品质与工艺说明图。核心任务：通过真实工艺、制造过程或品质细节建立价值感。受众：{由用户输入，或根据商品与用户资料总结}。主题：{由用户输入，或根据商品资料总结}。文案：{只使用用户提供的核对过的文案}。商品主体：{由用户指定、参考图识别或商品资料提取}。品质与工艺信息：{从用户资料中提取并整理为最有说服力的真实信息}。其余工艺呈现方式、细节表现与画面组织请自主完成。场景和周边元素可以采用指定画风，但是必须保持商品的写实风格。

本次输入：【填写商品外观、图的用途、已核对的规格与可展示文案】。
有事实、名称、数字或引文时，按输入使用；信息缺失的模块留空或省略。
promptEnglish:
E-commerce quality and craftsmanship explanatory image. Core task: Establish a sense of value through authentic craftsmanship, manufacturing processes, or quality details. Audience: {Input by user, or summarized based on product and user data}. Theme: {Input by user, or summarized based on product data}. Copy: {Use only approved copy supplied by the user}. Product subject: {Specified by user, recognized from reference image, or extracted from product data}. Quality and craftsmanship information: {Extracted from user data and organized into the most persuasive authentic information}. Autonomously design the craftsmanship presentation, detail rendering, and visual arrangement. Background scenes and surrounding elements may adopt the specified artistic style, but the product itself must strictly maintain a realistic photographic style.

Inputs: [Provide product appearance, purpose of the image, verified specifications, and approved copy].
Use supplied facts, names, numbers and quotations. Leave sections without data blank or omit them.

inputNote: 复制前填写商品外观、图的用途、已核对的规格与可展示文案。成图后核对内容对应位置、阅读顺序和文字。
